note: Namespace membership for generated message barrels (scripts/gen-message-namespaces.ts). A namespace is the unit of download: every message in one namespace ships together, and a namespace imported by a single route subtree gets its own chunk instead of being hoisted into a shared one. `prefixes` claims keys by `<prefix>_` prefix; `keys` claims exact keys and wins over prefixes. Every catalog key must be claimed exactly once or generation fails. See docs/quran-system.md (Part 2, Message chunking).

namespaces.description: Site chrome rendered on every marketing page: nav, footer, brand, skip link, locale switcher. Includes the appearance-panel trigger label, the only appearance string a page needs before the panel opens.
Theme mode names. Shared by chrome (nav toggle) and both appearance panels.
Parameterized control labels shared by the marketing and reader appearance panels.
Marketing appearance panel. Lazy: only downloaded once the panel is opened.
Marketing home page, including its SEO metadata.
FAQ page, including its FAQPage structured data.
Legal chrome shared by the privacy and terms pages.
Reader appearance panel. Lazy: only downloaded once the panel is opened.
Reader shell, sidebar, search, sources, verse tools, offline and update notices, reader SEO.

Settings page: storage, reading, privacy and account sections. Lazy: downloaded whole when the settings route loads or the reader appearance panel opens (offline-pack + notification toggle copy). The marketing appearance panel and the settings privacy section reuse reader_* notifications strings instead and never pull this namespace.
Auth modal + /login /register routes. Lazy: ships only inside the lazy auth chunk + auth routes.
